text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The final round of the Aoharu Cup. The 
members rejoiced, celebrating that they 
had all worked together to defeat a 
stronger Team First.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
To the defeated Acting Director Kashimoto, 
Little Cocon and the others gallantly 
reported that they had beaten their target 
time this morning.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She then reveals that she had been pushing 
herself to her limits all because she 
wanted her beloved Acting Director 
Kashimoto to break free from her rigid 
convictions.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Perhaps those feelings reached her, as 
Acting Director Kashimoto abolished the 
authoritarian management system. Stepping 
down from her post, she resolves to start 
over from scratch.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It is decided that she will work as a 
trainer at the academy from now on. Little 
Cocon and the others come rushing over to 
her.
